title.original: Batch Query Processing and Optimization for Agentic Workflows
title.zh: 代理工作流程的批量查询处理和优化
title.en: Batch Query Processing and Optimization for Agentic Workflows

inclusion_reason.zh: Halo 将 Agent 图编译为可优化查询计划，并在统一执行器中复用计算、KV 和异构硬件，属于批量工作流运行时。
inclusion_reason.en: Halo compiles agent graphs into optimizable query plans and reuses computation, KV state, and heterogeneous hardware in a shared processor, making it a batch-workflow runtime.

abstract.zh: Halo 把批量 Agent 工作流表示为查询计划 DAG，并将多个查询合并成暴露共享计算的统一图。成本模型联合考虑异构资源、预填充/解码、缓存复用与 GPU 放置，执行器再结合动态批处理、KV 共享迁移和 CPU–GPU 流水线。
abstract.en: Halo represents batched agent workflows as query-plan DAGs and consolidates them into a graph that exposes shared computation. A cost model covers heterogeneous resources, prefill/decode, cache reuse, and GPU placement, while the processor combines adaptive batching, KV sharing/migration, and CPU–GPU pipelining.

problem.zh: 服务引擎逐调用优化、Agent 框架只管逻辑，导致批量分析中的重复提示、重叠上下文和碎片化 CPU/GPU 步骤无法被全局消除。
problem.en: Serving engines optimize calls independently and agent frameworks optimize only logic, leaving repeated prompts, overlapping context, and fragmented CPU/GPU work unexploited in batch analytics.

approach.zh: Halo 合并多个工作流图并依据成本模型重写计划，识别可共享的预填充、工具和中间状态，再把优化图映射到异构处理器。
approach.en: Halo merges workflow graphs, rewrites the consolidated plan with a cost model, identifies reusable prefill, tool, and intermediate state, and maps the optimized graph to heterogeneous processors.

system_design.zh: 查询规划器构建跨请求 DAG 与共享子图，成本优化器选择放置和复用，Processor 在运行时执行自适应批次、KV 迁移及细粒度 CPU–GPU 重叠。
system_design.en: A planner builds cross-request DAGs and shared subgraphs, a cost optimizer selects placement and reuse, and the runtime Processor executes adaptive batches, KV migration, and fine-grained CPU–GPU overlap.

key_results.zh: 六个基准的结果报告 Halo 提高批量推理速度与在线吞吐，可扩展到数千查询和复杂图，同时保持输出质量。
key_results.en: Across six benchmarks, Halo is reported to accelerate batch inference and online throughput, scaling to thousands of queries and complex graphs without reducing output quality.

limitations.zh: 共享收益取决于批次间结构与上下文重合，成本模型误差会导致不佳放置；高度动态、带副作用工具或严格隔离的工作流可能难以合并。
limitations.en: Benefits depend on structural and contextual overlap, and cost-model error can misplace work; highly dynamic workflows, side-effecting tools, or strict tenant isolation may prevent consolidation.

evaluation.cluster_scale: thousands of queries and complex workflow graphs
baselines: existing LLM serving and agent orchestration systems

notes.zh: 六项基准、千级查询规模、异构执行与三项结论来自官方摘要；模型、GPU、基准名称和质量指标待全文审计。
notes.en: Six benchmarks, thousand-query scale, heterogeneous execution, and three conclusions come from the official abstract; models, GPUs, benchmark names, and quality metrics await full-text audit.
